technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with bullish moving average alignment, but extreme short-term overbought conditions (RSI-9 85.87, Stoch 95.41) without fresh momentum crossovers create pullback risk; moderate entry quality on sector-neutral backdrop.

fundamental.summary: CCI shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 56 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite congressional insider selling by Ro Khanna; lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (378.4) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severe risk environment; real estate sector particularly vulnerable to credit stress and rate uncertainty; earnings in 56 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with tech_score 7 and extreme fear sentiment (10/10) creates contrarian buy setup at support zone (151.72), offering asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (378.4), unfavorable macro (-3), high credit spreads, RSI-9 overbought without momentum confirmation (falling divergence), and zero fundamental support create a bear trap setup where technical strength masks deteriorating conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows SMA 9/21 golden cross at support with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian opportunity; however, this is severely undermined by RSI-9 overbought divergence, zero fundamental support, and macro crisis conditions.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (378.4) and high credit spreads create systemic risk to real estate sector; RSI-9 falling divergence signals momentum failure despite price strength, risking sharp pullback.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see opportunity; fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate correctly identifies bear trap setup.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 19 Real Estate positions and existing CCI position; concentration risk and sector saturation reduce conviction further; skip entry and monitor for macro stabilization.
